name: Bae Pyoun
source:
Likes: Prescription glasses, children, being right
Dislikes: Teenagers, physical exertion, surprises

Bae is a rather insufferable egotist with a smug smile that almost never falters. Every other thing he says is sarcastic or something cutely patronizing. He's convinced he's the most mature person in any room and is incapable of being friends with fellow teenagers because of that.

[From [url=https://gb-patch.tumblr.com/post/160243711416/we-made-some-shiny-new-character-bio-images-for]Tumblr[/url]]
